_comment: Example only. Copy the entry into config/local/servers.json (untracked). Official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server, MIT) runs as its OWN compose service (see the commented github-mcp service in docker-compose.yml) in HTTP mode. The gateway sends the token as a header. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in compose env. Verify the server's HTTP path for the pinned version; adjust 'url' to match.
